title: Arm Mbed OS FPGA Test Shield
summary: FPGA-based I/O test hardware, firmware and swappable board interfaces for Mbed OS boards.
role: IoT Engineering Intern; Graduate Software Engineer

dates.note: Initiated during the May–August 2018 internship and continued in the January 2019–April 2020 graduate role. No uninterrupted project start/end dates are inferred.

facts.text: Initiated work on the Mbed FPGA CI Test Shield during the 2018 IoT engineering internship.
Implemented Verilog FPGA master/slave test modules and C++ Mbed OS firmware for board I/O testing.
Wrote FPGA communication/test modules and corresponding Mbed OS application tests for I2C, GPIO, ADC, DAC and PWM.
Wrote Verilog testbenches and used waveform viewers to debug testbenches, RTL designs and IP source code.
Contributed to test-shield and form-factor PCBs, performed PCB testing/debugging, and debugged and fixed Mbed OS issues.
The FPGA was integrated into a physical PCB compatible with any Mbed OS board, according to the owner-provided project description.

notes: One project across internship and graduate employment, not two projects. Board-compatibility scope is owner reported, not a universal compatibility test rerun here. PCB contribution is not sole board ownership. Waveform viewers were used, not authored.
